summary: Record sampled, content-free writer queue wait and hold times with caller sites, and classify replication verdict chunks as background work so foreground writes receive bounded turns. The observed 3081 ms admission hold is not fixed: that admission loan was already background and remains non-preemptible.

rules.detail: Trust-root revalidation and replication verdict chunk boundaries remain unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Existing peers remain compatible; the existing writer scheduler is reused.

downtime.detail: No extra interruption beyond installing the updated daemon.

manual.detail: Writer lifetime child spans follow the existing sampled request context; no additional configuration is required.

recovery.detail: The previous binary remains usable without a store migration or rollback.
